content.title: About
content.content: Soft pretzels are a yeast‑leavened baked snack formed into twisted knots, frozen immediately after shaping. After thawing they retain a tender, slightly chewy texture and a mildly salty flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Soft pretzels originated in Central Europe, where they were traditionally shaped into knots.
Freezing locks in freshness and aroma without the need for preservatives.
In the United States they are often served with cheese sauce or mustard.
The classic recipe uses wheat flour, yeast, water, salt, and a touch of sugar.
There are flavored versions that include paprika, garlic, or other spices.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: Pretzels provide complex carbs that give lasting satiety.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Compared with many baked snacks, soft pretzels contain relatively little fat.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: The wheat flour supplies a modest amount of iron, important for blood formation.

items.title: Contains vitamin B6
items.content: Vitamin B6 supports protein metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Convenient to prepare
items.content: Thawing and a short bake take only a few minutes, making them a quick snack.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: Pretzels are made from wheat flour and are not suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Salt is added for flavor; those monitoring sodium intake should choose an unsalted version.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Because the carbs are quickly absorbed, pretzels can raise blood sugar levels.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Thaw at room temperature or in the microwave, then bake in a preheated oven for 5‑7 minutes until lightly golden. Serve as a snack on its own, with dips (cheese, mustard), or as a side to soups.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen pretzels in a sealed bag in the freezer at –18 °C. After thawing, consume within 2‑3 days and store in the refrigerator.
